title: Innovation, Licensing, and Competition: Evidence from Genetically Engineered Crops
abstract: We provide a novel empirical analysis of the role of technology licensing, between competitors, for genetically engineered (GE) traits in the US seed industry. We extend the standard differentiated‐product Bertrand pricing model to include trait licensing, which permits us to recover marginal costs and (otherwise unobserved) royalty rates. Estimation relies on a large dataset of farm‐level seed purchases. We find that markups over marginal cost are sizeable, and royalties for GE traits contribute a non‐trivial amount to these markups. Licensing GE traits to competitors benefits all seed sellers and, notwithstanding its strategic effect on pricing, also increases total market surplus.
abstract_zh: 我们对美国种子行业中竞争者之间针对转基因（GE）性状的技术许可作用进行了新颖的实证分析。我们将标准的差异化产品伯川德（Bertrand）定价模型扩展到包含性状许可，从而能够恢复边际成本以及（原本不可观测的）特许权使用费率。估计依赖于一个大规模的农场层面种子购买数据集。我们发现，超出边际成本的加成幅度相当可观，而转基因性状的特许权使用费对这些加成做出了不可忽视的贡献。向竞争者许可转基因性状既使所有种子销售商受益，并且尽管对定价产生了战略效应，也增加了总市场剩余。

title: Spatial Price Competition and Buyer Power in the U.S. Beef Packing Industry
Conflicting Markup Estimates and Cost minimization: The Semi-Nonparametric Translog Model
Genetically Engineered Crops and Pesticides: The Critical Nexus
abstract: This chapter examines the evolving relationship between pesticide use and the adoption of genetically engineered (GE) crops. Pesticides remain a central damage-control input in agriculture, delivering significant productivity and food-security benefits, yet their use is known to be associated with human health and environmental risks. Within this context, GE crops commercialized to date—primarily with insect-resistant (IR) and herbicide-tolerant (HT) traits—have fundamentally altered pest and weed management practices. Adoption of IR traits has provided farmers with insect control tool alternatives to insecticides, which tends to reduce pesticide treatments. By contrast, HT crops are designed to complement specific broad spectrum herbicides (glyphosate, in most cases), while potentially substituting for other compounds. We briefly review and discuss the main empirical studies on the interaction between GE crop adoption and pesticide use, and also provide detailed descriptive evidence on the evolution of pesticide use, since the introduction of GE crops, in four main U.S. crops: corn, cotton, soybeans, and wheat. The evidence suggests that IR crop adoption has led to persistent reductions in insecticide use and, in many cases, improved yields and farm profits. These benefits extend beyond adopters through regional pest suppression, although they are increasingly challenged by the evolution of pest resistance. The impacts of HT crops on herbicide use are more complex and dynamic. Early adoption was characterized by large substitution toward glyphosate and, in some cases, reductions in overall herbicide mass and toxicity. Over time, however, widespread glyphosate resistance has induced renewed use of multiple herbicides, raising application rates, costs, and management complexity, and in some cases reversing earlier environmental gains. These dynamics underscore the limitations of simple mass-based pesticide measures and the need to rely on toxicity-weighted metrics. The chapter further reviews evidence on indirect environmental effects, human health implications—particularly surrounding glyphosate exposure—and regulatory responses. Overall, the analysis highlights that the impacts of GE crops on pesticide use and the associated externalities are inherently dynamic and context-dependent. Assessments based on aggregate trends, or slanted towards early adoption patterns, can be misleading. As novel genomic techniques emerge to promise a new generation of GE products, understanding the substitution and complementarity effects between crop protection technologies and GE crops remains central for informed policy design and welfare analysis.
abstract_zh: 本章考察了农药使用与转基因（GE）作物采用之间不断演变的关系。农药仍是农业中核心的损害控制投入，在提高生产率和保障粮食安全方面作用显著，但其使用已知与人类健康和环境风险相关。在此背景下，迄今已商业化的转基因作物（主要具有抗虫（IR）和耐除草剂（HT）性状）从根本上改变了害虫和杂草的管理方式。采用抗虫性状为农民提供了替代杀虫剂的害虫防治工具，这往往会减少农药施用。相比之下，耐除草剂作物的设计目的是与特定的广谱除草剂（大多数情况下为草甘膦）配合使用，同时可能替代其他化合物。我们简要回顾并讨论了关于转基因作物采用与农药使用之间相互作用的主要实证研究，并提供了美国四种主要作物（玉米、棉花、大豆和小麦）自转基因作物引入以来农药使用演变的详细描述性证据。证据表明，抗虫作物的采用使杀虫剂使用持续减少，并且在许多情况下提高了产量和农场利润。这些收益通过区域性害虫抑制惠及非采用者，尽管这一收益正日益受到害虫抗性演变的挑战。耐除草剂作物对除草剂使用的影响则更为复杂和动态。早期采用阶段的特点是大量替代为草甘膦，在某些情况下，除草剂的总用量和毒性有所降低。然而，随着草甘膦抗性的广泛出现，多种除草剂的重新使用又再度增加，施用量、成本和管理复杂性随之上升，在某些情况下甚至逆转了早期的环境收益。这些动态凸显了基于质量的农药指标的局限性，以及依赖毒性加权指标的必要性。本章进一步回顾了关于间接环境效应、人类健康影响（尤其是围绕草甘膦暴露的问题）以及监管应对的证据。总体而言，分析表明，转基因作物对农药使用及相关外部性的影响具有内在的动态性和情境依赖性。基于总体趋势或偏重早期采用模式的评估可能会产生误导。随着新型基因组技术的出现，有望推出新一代转基因产品，理解作物保护技术与转基因作物之间的替代和互补效应，对于制定知情的政策和进行福利分析仍然至关重要。

Major Impacts of the U.S. Renewable Fuel Standard on Corn and Soybean Cultivation
venue: Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association
abstract: We use rich spatial data on observed crop choices and ethanol production to estimate the local impacts of ethanol plants and the overall impact of the 2007 US Renewable Fuel Standard (the RFS2) on crop patterns. We find that the RFS2 increased total corn area by 9.7%, corn monoculture by 16.8%, and soybean area by 6.7%, with notable spatial heterogeneity in both the overall impact and the local effects of ethanol plants. The results indicate an RFS2‐induced shift in the geography of corn and soybean cultivation within the Corn Belt—intensification in the core, and significant expansion near the periphery.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丰富的空间数据，分析了观察到的作物选择和乙醇生产情况，以估计乙醇工厂的局部影响，以及2007年美国《可再生燃料标准》（RFS2）对作物格局的总体影响。我们发现，RFS2使玉米总种植面积增加了9.7%，玉米单作增加了16.8%，大豆种植面积增加了6.7%；其总体影响及乙醇工厂的局部效应均存在显著的空间异质性。结果表明，RFS2引发了玉米带内玉米和大豆种植地理格局的转移：核心区趋于集约化，而边缘地区则出现了显著扩张。

Agricultural Innovation and Adaptation to Climate Change: Insights from U.S. Maize
venue: Journal of Agricultural & Applied Economics Association
abstract: Climate change is a major threat to the global food supply, and adaptation by technological progress is essential. We show that the scope of the required innovation is challenging. Our benchmark is the estimated yield gain in US maize due to genetically engineered (GE) varieties. Extrapolated future yields, given climate projections, indicate significant negative impacts of climate change. Yield shortfalls, by the end of the century, range from 2.8 to 6.3 times the total yield gains from first‐generation GE varieties. Ambitious and targeted R&D efforts, and innovation breakthroughs, may be required to offset the negative impact of climate change.
abstract_zh: 气候变化是对全球粮食供应的重大威胁，通过技术进步实现适应至关重要。我们表明，所需创新的规模具有挑战性。我们的基准是转基因（GE）品种为美国玉米带来的估计产量增益。根据气候预测外推的未来产量表明，气候变化将带来显著的负面影响。到本世纪末，产量缺口将是第一代转基因品种总产量增益的2.8至6.3倍。可能需要雄心勃勃且有针对性的研发努力以及创新突破，以抵消气候变化的负面影响。

The Roots of Agricultural Innovation: Patent Evidence of Knowledge Spillovers (book chapter)
abstract: This chapter investigates the extent to which agricultural innovations draw on ideas originating outside of agriculture. We identify a large set of US patents for agricultural technologies granted between 1976 and 2018.To measure knowledge spillovers to these patents, we rely on three proxies: patent citations to other patents, patent citations to the scientific literature, and a novel text analysis to identify and track new ideas in the patent text. We find that more than half of knowledge flows originate outside of agriculture. The majority of these knowledge inflows, however, still originate in domains that are close to agriculture.
abstract_zh: 本章探讨了农业创新在多大程度上借鉴了农业以外的思想。我们识别出1976至2018年间授予的大量美国农业技术专利。为衡量这些专利的知识溢出，我们依赖三种代理指标：专利对其他专利的引用、专利对科学文献的引用，以及一种用于识别和追踪专利文本中新思想的新颖文本分析方法。我们发现，超过一半的知识流动来源于农业以外。然而，这些知识流入大多仍来自与农业相近的领域。

Mandates and the Incentive for Environmental Innovation
abstract: Mandates, which establish minimum use quotas for certain goods, are becoming increasingly popular policy tools to promote renewable energy use. In addition to mitigating the pollution externality of conventional energy, clean energy mandates have the goal of promoting research and development (R&D) investments in renewable energy technology. But how well do mandates perform as innovation incentives? To address this question, we develop a partial equilibrium model to examine the R&D incentives induced by a mandate, and compare this policy to two benchmark situations: laissez faire and a carbon tax. Innovation is stochastic and the model permits an endogenous number of multiple innovators. We present both analytical results and conclusions based on numerical simulations. We find that the optimal mandate is larger than it would be without the prospect of innovation, that neglecting the outlook for innovation significantly reduces welfare, and that the optimal mandate is more sensitive to assumptions about the innovation process than an optimal carbon tax. Furthermore, we find that mandates create relatively strong incentives for R&D investment in low‐quality innovations, but relatively weak incentives to invest in high‐quality innovations. We also rank policies by expected welfare. An optimal carbon tax has higher expected welfare than an optimal mandate, and both have higher expected welfare than laissez faire. Moreover, in our endogenous innovation setting, a stronger result obtains: a simple carbon tax equal to the damage from pollution (unadjusted for the prospect of innovation) has higher expected welfare than an optimal mandate.
abstract_zh: 强制性配额（即规定某些商品的最低使用量）正日益成为促进可再生能源使用的流行政策工具。除了缓解传统能源的污染外部性之外，清洁能源强制性配额还旨在促进可再生能源技术的研发（R&D）投资。但是，强制性配额作为创新激励手段的效果如何？为探讨这一问题，我们建立了一个局部均衡模型，考察强制性配额所诱导的研发激励，并将该政策与两种基准情形进行比较：自由放任和碳税。创新具有随机性，且模型允许存在内生数量的多个创新者。我们既给出了解析结果，也给出了基于数值模拟的结论。我们发现：最优强制性配额大于在不考虑创新前景时的水平；忽视创新前景会显著降低福利；且最优强制性配额比最优碳税对创新过程的假设更为敏感。此外，我们发现，强制性配额对低质量创新的研发投资激励相对较强，但对高质量创新的投资激励相对较弱。我们还按预期福利对政策进行了排序：最优碳税的预期福利高于最优强制性配额，而两者的预期福利都高于自由放任。而且，在我们内生创新的设定中，有一个更强的结论：一个等于污染损害的简单碳税（未根据创新前景进行调整），其预期福利高于最优强制性配额。

title: The Dynamics of Supply: U.S. Corn and Soybeans in the Biofuel Era
Threshold Cointegration and Spatial Price Transmission when Expectations Matter
Intellectual Property Rights and the Ascent of Proprietary Innovation in Agriculture
abstract: Biological innovations in agriculture did not enjoy protection by formal intellectual property rights (IPRs) for a long time, but the recent trend has been one of considerable broadening and strengthening of these rights. We document the nature and evolution of these IPRs and provide an assessment of their impacts on innovation. We integrate elements of the institutional history of plant IPRs with a discussion of the relevant economic theory and a review of applicable empirical evidence. Throughout this review, we highlight how the experience of biological innovation mirrors or differs from the broader literature on IPRs and innovation. We conclude with some considerations on the relationship between IPRs, market structure, and the pricing of proprietary inputs in agriculture.
abstract_zh: 农业领域的生物创新长期未受到正式知识产权（IPR）的保护，但近来的趋势是这些权利得到了显著的拓宽和强化。我们记录了这些知识产权的性质与演变，并评估了它们对创新的影响。我们将植物知识产权的制度史要素与相关经济理论的讨论以及适用实证证据的综述结合起来。在整个综述过程中，我们着重说明生物创新的经验与更广泛的知识产权与创新文献之间是如何相互呼应或存在差异的。最后，我们就知识产权、市场结构与农业中专有投入品定价之间的关系提出了一些思考。

title: Genetically engineered crops and pesticide use in U.S. maize and soybeans
abstract: The widespread adoption of genetically engineered (GE) crops has clearly led to changes in pesticide use, but the nature and extent of these impacts remain open questions. We study this issue with a unique, large, and representative sample of plot-level choices made by U.S. maize and soybean farmers from 1998 to 2011. On average, adopters of GE glyphosate-tolerant (GT) soybeans used 28% (0.30 kg/ha) more herbicide than nonadopters, adopters of GT maize used 1.2% (0.03 kg/ha) less herbicide than nonadopters, and adopters of GE insect-resistant (IR) maize used 11.2% (0.013 kg/ha) less insecticide than nonadopters. When pesticides are weighted by the environmental impact quotient, however, we find that (relative to nonadopters) GE adopters used about the same amount of soybean herbicides, 9.8% less of maize herbicides, and 10.4% less of maize insecticides. In addition, the results indicate that the difference in pesticide use between GE and non-GE adopters has changed significantly over time. For both soybean and maize, GT adopters used increasingly more herbicides relative to nonadopters, whereas adopters of IR maize used increasingly less insecticides. The estimated pattern of change in herbicide use over time is consistent with the emergence of glyphosate weed resistance.
abstract_zh: 转基因作物的广泛采用无疑改变了农药的使用，但其影响的性质和程度仍是有待解决的问题。我们利用一个独特、规模庞大且具有代表性的样本进行研究，该样本包含1998至2011年间美国玉米和大豆种植者在地块层面的选择数据。平均而言，采用转基因草甘膦耐受（GT）大豆的农户比未采用者多使用28%（0.30千克/公顷）的除草剂；采用GT玉米的农户比未采用者少使用1.2%（0.03千克/公顷）的除草剂；采用转基因抗虫（IR）玉米的农户比未采用者少使用11.2%（0.013千克/公顷）的杀虫剂。然而，当农药用量以环境影响商（environmental impact quotient）加权时，我们发现：相对于未采用者，转基因采用者的大豆除草剂用量大致相同，玉米除草剂用量少9.8%，玉米杀虫剂用量少10.4%。此外，结果表明，转基因与非转基因采用者之间的农药使用差异随时间发生了显著变化。对于大豆和玉米而言，GT采用者相对于未采用者使用的除草剂越来越多，而IR玉米采用者使用的杀虫剂则越来越少。除草剂使用随时间变化的估计模式，与草甘膦抗性杂草的出现相一致。

title: Productivity, Export and Environmental Performance: Air Pollutants in the United States
abstract: This paper studies the firm‐level relationship among productivity, decision to export, and environmental performance. The emerging theoretical and empirical literature suggests that trade has an important role in determining firms' heterogeneity: increased openness to trade induces a reallocation effect that increases within‐industry efficiency, thereby linking firms' decisions to export and adopt newer (and cleaner) technology. We argue that this framework provides the following empirically‐relevant predictions: there is an inverse relationship between firm productivity and pollution emissions per unit output; exporting firms have lower emissions per unit output; and larger firms have a lower emission intensity. To examine these implications empirically, we have assembled a uniquely detailed dataset of the U.S. manufacturing industry for the years 2002, 2005, and 2008 by matching facility‐level air emission data from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency with the facility's economic characteristics contained in the National Establishment Time Series database. The strategy is to first estimate a facility‐level total factor productivity parameter as a plant‐specific fixed effect. We then investigate how this estimated productivity parameter correlates with emission intensity on a pollutant‐by‐pollutant basis. Our empirical findings support the hypotheses suggested by the conceptual model. For each criteria air pollutant considered, we find a significant negative correlation between estimated facility productivity and emission intensity. Conditional on a facility's estimated productivity and other controls, exporting facilities have significantly lower emissions per value of sales than non‐exporting facilities in the same industry. We also find that plant size is negatively and significantly related to emission intensity for all pollutants.
abstract_zh: 本文考察企业层面生产率、出口决策与环境绩效之间的关系。新兴的理论与实证文献表明，贸易在决定企业异质性方面发挥着重要作用：贸易开放度的提高会引发资源再配置效应，从而提高行业内效率，进而将企业的出口决策与采用更新（更清洁）技术的决策联系起来。我们认为，这一框架提供了以下具有实证意义的预测：企业生产率与单位产出的污染排放之间存在负相关关系；出口企业的单位产出排放更低；规模更大的企业排放强度更低。为了对这些推论进行实证检验，我们将美国环境保护署（EPA）的设施层面空气排放数据与国家企业时间序列数据库（NETS）中设施的经济特征相匹配，构建了一个美国制造业的独特详细数据集，覆盖2002年、2005年和2008年。我们的策略是：首先将设施层面的全要素生产率参数估计为工厂特定的固定效应，然后逐一污染物考察该估计生产率与排放强度之间的相关性。实证结果支持概念模型所提出的假说。对于所考虑的每一种标准空气污染物，我们都发现估计的设施生产率与排放强度之间存在显著的负相关。在控制设施估计生产率及其他控制变量的条件下，出口设施每单位销售额的排放显著低于同一行业中的非出口设施。我们还发现，对于所有污染物，工厂规模均与排放强度呈显著负相关。

title: Testing for Complementarity: Glyphosate Tolerant Soybeans and Conservation Tillage
abstract: Many decisions in agriculture are made over combinations of inputs and/or practices that may form a technology system linked through complementarity. The presence of complementarity among producer decisions can have far‐reaching implications for market outcomes and for the effectiveness of policies intended to influence them. Identifying complementarity relations, however, is made difficult by the presence of unobserved heterogeneity. Drawing on recent methodological advances, in this paper we develop a test for complementarity between glyphosate tolerant soybeans and conservation tillage that overcomes certain limitations of previous studies. Specifically, we develop a structural discrete choice framework of joint soybean‐tillage adoption that explicitly models both complementarity and the correlation induced by unobserved heterogeneity. The model is estimated with a large unbalanced panel of farm‐level choices spanning the 1998–2011 period. We find that glyphosate tolerant soybeans and conservation tillage are complementary practices. In addition, our estimation shows that farm operation scale promotes the adoption of both conservation tillage and glyphosate tolerant seed, and that all of higher fuel prices, more droughty conditions, and soil erodibility increase use of conservation tillage. We apply our results to simulate annual adoption rates for both conservation tillage and no‐tillage in a scenario without glyphosate tolerant soybeans available as a choice. We find that the adoption of conservation tillage and no‐tillage have been about 10% and 20% higher, respectively, due to the advent of glyphosate tolerant soybeans.
abstract_zh: 农业中的许多决策是围绕投入品和/或措施的组合做出的，这些组合可能通过互补性形成一个技术体系。生产者决策之间存在的互补性，可能对市场结果以及影响这些决策的政策有效性产生深远影响。然而，由于存在不可观测的异质性，识别互补关系十分困难。借鉴近期的方法学进展，本文提出了一种检验草甘膦耐受大豆与保护性耕作之间互补性的方法，该方法克服了以往研究的某些局限。具体而言，我们构建了一个联合大豆—耕作采用的结构离散选择框架，该框架同时明确刻画了互补性以及不可观测异质性所引起的相关性。模型利用1998至2011年间农场层面选择的大型非平衡面板数据进行估计。我们发现，草甘膦耐受大豆与保护性耕作是互补性的措施。此外，我们的估计表明，农场经营规模促进了保护性耕作和草甘膦耐受种子的采用，而更高的燃料价格、更干旱的条件以及土壤可蚀性，都会增加保护性耕作的使用。我们将结果应用于模拟保护性耕作和免耕的年度采用率，假设情景中不存在草甘膦耐受大豆这一选项。我们发现，由于草甘膦耐受大豆的出现，保护性耕作和免耕的采用率分别比不存在该选项时高出约10%和20%。

abstract: Yield improvements are critical to ensuring food security for a growing world population especially in view of the increasing potential for use of land in biofuel production. Efforts to sustain the impressive rate of past productivity gains, epitomized by such successes as the Green Revolution, are bound to rely on biotechnology innovations such as those responsible for the development of genetically engineered (GE) crops. Some argue that the use of biotechnology can substantially improve yields relative to the trajectory established by traditional breeding in the 20th century. Because U.S. adoption of GE varieties has been very strong since their introduction in the late 1990s, we investigated empirically whether and to what extent the GE technology has improved realized yields. We study this question for nonirrigated U.S. maize (Zea mays L.) and soybean [Glycine max (L.) Merr.] yields over 1964 through 2010, having controlled for local effects, weather, fertilization, and the preexisting (non‐GE) crop improvement trend. For maize we find that GE varieties have increased realized yields, with a stronger gain in the Central Corn Belt (CCB). For soybeans, GE varieties appear to have slightly reduced yields. For both crops we find a strong trend in yield growth, which may have accelerated in recent years within the CCB. However, the combined effects of yield trend and GE adoption are predicted to fall short of the growth rate envisioned by industry projections.

Merr.］的产量为研究对象，并控制了地方效应、天气、施肥以及既有的（非转基因）作物改良趋势。对于玉米，我们发现转基因品种提高了实际产量，且在中部玉米带（CCB）增益更为显著。对于大豆，转基因品种似乎略微降低了产量。对于这两种作物，我们都发现了强劲的产量增长趋势，且在近年来中部玉米带内这一趋势可能有所加速。然而，产量趋势与转基因技术采用的综合效应所预测的增长速度，仍将低于行业预测所设想的增长率。

abstract: An open‐economy equilibrium model is derived to investigate the effects of energy policy on the U.S. economy, with emphasis on corn‐based ethanol. A second best policy of a fuel tax and ethanol subsidy is found to approximate fairly closely the welfare gains associated with the first best policy of an optimal carbon tax and tariffs on traded goods. The largest economic gains to the U.S. economy from these energy policies arise from their impact on U.S. terms of trade, particularly in the oil market. Conditional on the current fuel tax, an optimal ethanol mandate is superior to an optimal ethanol subsidy.

abstract: The economics of geographical indications (GIs) is assessed within a vertical product differentiation framework that is consistent with the competitive structure of agriculture. It is assumed that certification costs are needed for GIs to serve as (collective) credible quality certification devices, and production of high‐quality product is endogenously determined. We find that GIs can support a competitive provision of quality and lead to clear welfare gains, although they fall short of delivering the (constrained) first best. The main beneficiaries are consumers. Producers may also accrue some benefit if production of the high‐quality products draws on scarce factors that they own.

abstract: A partial equilibrium four‐region world trade model for the soybean complex is developed in which Roundup Ready (RR) products are weakly inferior substitutes to conventional ones, RR seeds are priced at a premium, and costly segregation is necessary to separate conventional and biotech products. Solution of the calibrated model illustrates how incomplete adoption of RR technology arises in equilibrium. The United States, Argentina, Brazil, and the Rest of the World (ROW) all gain from the introduction of RR soybeans, although some groups may lose. The impacts of RR production or import bans by the ROW or Brazil are analyzed. U.S. price support helps U.S. farmers, despite hurting the United States and has the potential to improve world efficiency.

abstract: We review intellectual property rights in agriculture and outline a modeling framework that accounts for relevant institutional features of agricultural R…D. The analysis emphasizes vertical market linkages whereby agricultural innovations adopted by farmers are produced upstream by input suppliers. It is argued that the conventional assumption of competitive pricing cannot hold when new technologies are produced by private firms because such innovations are typically protected by intellectual property rights (such as patents) that confer (limited) monopoly rights to discoverers. The implications of intellectual property rights for the welfare evaluation of agricultural R…D are derived, and it is shown that conventional methods usually overestimate the welfare gains from agricultural innovations.

abstract: When lump‐sum taxation is not feasible, decoupled transfers to farmers (which require raising government revenue) will entail welfare loss somewhere in the economy. Assuming the government's objective is to assure a given welfare level for farmers, we show that when decoupling is possible, free trade is always superior to some tariff protection for a small country, even under distortionary taxation. As expected, for a large country there is scope for an optimal tariff policy that improves the terms of trade. However, we show a separation between the exercise of market power through an optimal tariff, and the interaction of distortionary taxation with transfers to farmers. We conclude that decoupling is usually desirable, even in a distorted economy in which lump‐sum taxation is not feasible.
abstract_zh: 当一次性总额税（lump-sum taxation）不可行时，对农民的脱钩转移支付（需要政府筹集收入）将在经济的某个环节带来福利损失。假设政府的目标是保证农民达到一个给定的福利水平，我们证明：在可以实行脱钩的情况下，即使存在扭曲性税收，对于小国而言，自由贸易总是优于某种程度的关税保护。正如预期的那样，对于大国而言，存在通过最优关税改善贸易条件的政策空间。然而，我们揭示了两者之间的分离：一方面是通过最优关税行使市场势力，另一方面是扭曲性税收与对农民的转移支付之间的相互作用。我们的结论是，即使在存在扭曲且无法实行一次性总额税的经济中，脱钩通常也是可取的。

abstract: The production structure of the Canadian agricultural sector is modeled by an output‐constrained multiproduct profit function to account for the existence of supply management policies. The le Chatelier effects of supply constraints are illustrated, and the comparative statics of supply management is shown to depend, under input normality, on the type of jointness. Convexity is tested and accepted, and nonjointness is rejected by the estimated normalized quadratic profit function. The results support the hypothesis of nonjointness due to allocatable fixed factors. Decreasing the supply of managed commodities will increase the supply of unrestricted commodities, while total input use is reduced.

abstract:
This paper utilizes the capital asset pricing model, together with available econometric estimates of the cost function of Ontario dairy farms, to estimate rates of returns for three types of milk quotas. The estimated rates follow the trend of the interest rate in the economy, and the rate of return on fluid milk quota is higher than the rate of return on industrial milk quotas.
Cet article utilise un modèle de formation des prix des actifs, avec des estimées économetriques de la fonction de coûts des producteurs laitiers de ľOntario, pour estimer les taux de retour associés avec trois differents types de quotas laitiers. Les taux estimés suivent la même tendence que le taux ďintérêt dans ľéconomie, et le taux de retour du quota pour le lait fluide est plus elevée que les taux de retour du quotas pour le lait industriel.
